summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 new features: Redesigned Bookings page with status tabs, Services CRUD page, and Analytics page with filters. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified with Playwright automation.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/bookings/by-status - returns all 5 status categories (checked_in_today, upcoming, confirmed, checked_out, cancelled)
✅ Bookings have all required fields (id, company_id, property_id, guest_name, check_in, check_out, total_amount, status)
✅ Bookings sorted correctly by check_in date
✅ POST /api/services - creates service with internal provider
✅ POST /api/services - creates service with external provider
✅ GET /api/services - lists all services
✅ GET /api/services?category=X - filters by category
✅ PUT /api/services/{id} - updates service
✅ DELETE /api/services/{id} - deletes service
✅ GET /api/analytics - returns current, previous, changes, and 12-month trends
✅ Analytics has all 8 KPIs (revenue, net_income, occupancy_rate, nights_booked, adr, revpan, active_properties, total_bookings)
✅ GET /api/analytics?property_id=X - filters by property
✅ GET /api/analytics?year=X&month=Y - filters by year and month
✅ Analytics trends contains 12 months of data
✅ Analytics changes (percentage) calculated correctly
✅ All service categories work (airport_transfer, meals, excursions, spa, transport, other)
✅ Frontend: Bookings page loads with all 5 status tabs
✅ Frontend: OTA Sync button is clickable and refreshes bookings
✅ Frontend: Add Booking button opens modal with all form fields
✅ Frontend: Booking tabs switch correctly and display correct data
✅ Frontend: Services page loads with category filter tabs
✅ Frontend: Add Service modal has provider type selection (internal/external)
✅ Frontend: External provider fields appear when selected
✅ Frontend: Analytics page loads with all 8 KPI cards
✅ Frontend: Property filter dropdown works
✅ Frontend: Month filter dropdown works
✅ Frontend: Year filter dropdown works
✅ Frontend: Revenue trend chart displays 12-month data
✅ Frontend: Occupancy chart displays
✅ Frontend: ADR chart displays
✅ Frontend: Services and Analytics nav links visible for admin
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features fully tested: (1) Bookings page redesigned with 5 status tabs (checked_in_today, upcoming, confirmed, checked_out, cancelled), OTA Sync button, and proper table display per tab. (2) Services page with CRUD operations, category filter tabs, internal staff and external provider assignment. (3) Analytics page with 8 KPIs, property/month/year filters, and multiple charts (revenue trend, occupancy, ADR). All backend APIs and frontend UIs working correctly.
